name: rtest-forked-constants
summary: Temporary PyPI fork of rtest 0.0.47 with constructor-call parametrize IDs, pytest-version-aware duplicate IDs, broader static argvalue evaluation, get_args/constructor/factory-call resolution, pytest-compatible IDs for runtime-only expressions, configurable parametrize wrappers, dict .items() expansion, literal-values helpers, star imports, and record attribute IDs. Import and CLI remain `rtest`.
